gist.summary: The OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/audio/speech route now forwards speed to Azure tts-1 and tts-1-hd instead of silently dropping it; Azure validates the supported 0.25–4 range. Other models return 400 for speeds other than 1, naming the supported models, while speed: 1 remains valid for every model. GET /audio/{text} is unchanged. The existing POST-body cache key keeps requests at different speeds separate.
